### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statslogging)
stats.logging

*   类型： `'info' | 'none' | 'error' | 'warn' | 'log' | 'verbose' | boolean`

是否展示 [`compilation.getLogger`](https://rspack.rs/zh/api/javascript-api/compilation#getlogger)
 所记录的日志信息。

*   `'none'`, `false`: 禁用日志
*   `'error'`: 仅展示错误
*   `'warn'`: 仅展示错误与告警
*   `'info'`: 展示错误，告警与信息
*   `'log'`, `true`: 展示错误，告警与信息，日志，分组，清理信息。被折叠的部分也会以折叠状态展示。
*   `'verbose'`: 输出所有日志除了调试信息和堆栈信息。被折叠的部分也会以展开状态展示。

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statsloggingdebug)
stats.loggingDebug

*   **类型：**

    type FilterItemTypes = RegExp | string | ((value: string) => boolean);
    type StatsLoggingDebug = boolean | FilterItemTypes | FilterItemTypes[];

是否展示插件和 loader 中指定 [Logger](https://rspack.rs/zh/api/javascript-api/logger)
 的调试信息。当 `stats.logging` 为 `false` 时 `stats.loggingDebug` 会被忽略。

rspack.config.mjs

    export default {
      stats: {
        loggingDebug: [\
          'MyPlugin',\
          /rspack/, // 获取 Rspack 内部的日志\
        ],
      },
    };

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statsloggingtrace)
stats.loggingTrace

*   类型： `boolean`
*   默认值：`true`

是否展示堆栈信息。

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statscolors)
stats.colors

*   **类型：**

    type StatsColorOptions = {
      bold?: string;
      cyan?: string;
      green?: string;
      magenta?: string;
      red?: string;
      yellow?: string;
    };
    
    type StatsColors = boolean | StatsColorOptions;

*   **默认值：** 根据当前环境决定

是否在展示日志时添加颜色。

当传入对象时，可以自定义每种支持颜色使用的 ANSI 转义序列。默认情况下，Rspack 会在当前环境支持颜色输出时启用颜色。

[#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#compilation-%E9%80%89%E9%A1%B9)
Compilation 选项
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statshash)
stats.hash

*   类型： `boolean`
*   默认值：`true`

是否展示本次构建的哈希。

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statsenv)
stats.env

*   类型： `boolean`
*   默认值：`false`

是否展示 `--env` 参数传入的信息。

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statsbuiltat)
stats.builtAt

*   类型： `boolean`
*   默认值：`true`

是否展示构建的开始时间点。

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statsversion)
stats.version

*   类型： `boolean`
*   默认值：`true`

是否展示 Rspack 的版本号。

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statspublicpath)
stats.publicPath

*   类型： `boolean`
*   默认值：`true`

是否展示产物的[加载路径](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/output#outputpublicpath)
。

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statsoutputpath)
stats.outputPath

*   类型： `boolean`
*   默认值：`true`

是否展示产物的[输出路径](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/output#outputpath)
。

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statschildren)
stats.children

*   类型： `boolean`
*   默认值：`true`

是否展示 childCompiler 的 stats 信息。

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statsperformance)
stats.performance

*   类型： `boolean`
*   默认值：`true`

是否展示产物文件超过 [`performance.maxAssetSize`](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/performance#performancemaxassetsize)
 配置时的提示信息。

### [#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#statstimings)
stats.timings

*   类型： `boolean`
*   默认值：`true`

是否展示本次构建的耗时。

[#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#%E5%AD%97%E6%AE%B5%E6%8E%92%E5%BA%8F)
字段排序
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

对于 `assetsSort`, `chunksSort` 和 `modulesSort` 它们有几个可用的字段用于排序：

*   `'id'`: 是元素（指资源，Chunk 或模块，下同）的 id
*   `'name'`: 元素的名称，在导引的时候被分配
*   `'size'`: 元素的大小，单位字节（bytes）
*   `'chunks'`: 元素来源于哪些 chunks（例如，一个 Chunk 有多个子 Chunk，子 Chunk 会被基于主 Chunk 组合到一起）
*   `'errors'`: 元素中的错误数量
*   `'warnings'`: 元素中的告警数量
*   `'failed'`: 元素是否编译失败
*   `'cacheable'`: 元素是否可被缓存
*   `'built'`: 资源是否被构建
*   `'prefetched'`: 资源是否可被预取
*   `'optional'`: 资源是否可选
*   `'identifier'`: 元素的标识符
*   `'index'`: 元素处理顺序
*   `'issuer'`: 上游（issuer）的标识符
*   `'issuerId'`: 上游（issuer）的 ID
*   `'issuerName'`: 上游（issuer）的名称
*   `'issuerPath'`: 完整的上游（issuer）路径

[#](https://rspack.rs/zh/config/stats#%E6%89%A9%E5%B1%95%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA%E8%A1%8C%E4%B8%BA)
扩展信息输出行为
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

如果你想使用预设的输出行为，但又想对个别字段进行自定义设置，可以在指定 `stats.preset` 或 `stats.all` 之后对字段的输出行为进行自定义。

举例来说，只输出错误和模块被引入的原因：

rspack.config.mjs

    export default {
      stats: {
        preset: 'errors-only',
        reasons: true,
      },
    };

---

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#stats)
Stats
===============================================

Copy Markdown

Generate packaging information that can be used to analyze module dependencies and optimize compilation speed.

Output JSON file of stats

*   Using `@rspack/cli`, `rspack build --json stats.json`.
*   Using Rspack's JavaScript API, `stats.toJson(options)`, `stats.toString(options)`.

*   **Type:**

    type StatsPresets =
      | 'normal'
      | 'none'
      | 'verbose'
      | 'errors-only'
      | 'errors-warnings'
      | 'minimal'
      | 'detailed'
      | 'summary';
    
    type Stats = boolean | StatsOptions | StatsPresets;

*   **Default in `@rspack/core`:** `{}`
*   **Default in `@rspack/cli`:** `{ "preset":"errors-warnings", "timings":true, "logging":false }`

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#stats-presets)
Stats presets
---------------------------------------------------------------

| Preset | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `'normal'` (`true`) | Output by default value of stats options |
| `'none'` (`false`) | Output nothing |
| `'verbose'` | Output everything |
| `'errors-only'` | Output only error-related information |
| `'errors-warnings'` | Output only error and warning related information |
| `'minimal'` | Output only when errors or new compilation happen |
| `'detailed'` | Output everything except `chunkModules` and `chunkRootModules` |
| `'summary'` | Output only the summary information |

You can specify exactly which packing information to output, all the following fields are optional.

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#preset-options)
Preset options
-----------------------------------------------------------------

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsall)
stats.all

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`undefined`

A fallback value for stats options when an option is not defined. It has precedence over local Rspack defaults.

Warning

Enabling `stats.all` will lead to a large amount of data transmission between Rust and JavaScript, which will significantly increase the time consumption for stats generation. Please use it with caution.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statspreset)
stats.preset

*   Type: `boolean | StatsPresets`
*   Default:`undefined`

Sets the [preset](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#stats-presets)
 for the type of information that gets displayed. It is useful for [extending stats behaviours](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#extending-stats-behaviours)
.

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#asset-options)
Asset options
---------------------------------------------------------------

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsassets)
stats.assets

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display the asset information. See [Asset Object](https://rspack.rs/api/javascript-api/stats-json#asset-object)
 for more details.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsassetssort)
stats.assetsSort

*   Type: `string`
*   Default:`"id"`

Sort the assets by a given field. All of the [sorting fields](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#sorting-fields)
 are allowed to be used. Use `!` prefix in the value to reverse the sort order by a given field.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsassetsspace)
stats.assetsSpace

*   Type: `number`
*   Default:`15`

How many items of assets should be displayed (groups will be collapsed to fit this space).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsrelatedassets)
stats.relatedAssets

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`false`

Whether to display information about assets that are related to other assets (like SourceMaps for assets).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsexcludeassets)
stats.excludeAssets

*   Type: `boolean | string | RegExp | ((name: string, asset: any) => boolean) | Array<string | RegExp | ((name: string, asset: any) => boolean)>`
*   Default:`false`

Exclude the matching assets information. This can be done with a string, a RegExp, or a function that receives the asset name and asset object and returns a boolean. `stats.excludeAssets` can be an array of any of the above.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statscachedassets)
stats.cachedAssets

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about the cached assets. Setting `stats.cachedAssets` to `false` will tell stats to only show the emitted files (not the ones that were built).

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#asset-grouping-options)
Asset grouping options
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupassetsbychunk)
stats.groupAssetsByChunk

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to group assets by how their are related to chunks.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupassetsbyemitstatus)
stats.groupAssetsByEmitStatus

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to group assets by their status (emitted, compared for emit or cached).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupassetsbyextension)
stats.groupAssetsByExtension

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to group assets by their extension.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupassetsbyinfo)
stats.groupAssetsByInfo

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to group assets by their asset info (immutable, development, hotModuleReplacement, etc).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupassetsbypath)
stats.groupAssetsByPath

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to group assets by their asset path.

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#chunk-options)
Chunk options
---------------------------------------------------------------

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunks)
stats.chunks

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about the chunk, see [chunk object](https://rspack.rs/api/javascript-api/stats-json#chunk-object)
 for more details.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunkmodules)
stats.chunkModules

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about the built modules to information about the chunk.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunkmodulesspace)
stats.chunkModulesSpace

*   Type: `number`
*   Default:`10`

How many items of chunk modules should be displayed (groups will be collapsed to fit this space).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunkmodulessort)
stats.chunkModulesSort

*   Type: `string`
*   Default:`"name"`

Sort the chunk modules by a given field. All of the [sorting fields](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#sorting-fields)
 are allowed to be used. Use `!` prefix in the value to reverse the sort order by a given field.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsdependentmodules)
stats.dependentModules

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`false`

Whether to display chunk modules that are dependencies of other modules of the chunk.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunkorigins)
stats.chunkOrigins

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about the origins of chunks and chunk merging.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunkrelations)
stats.chunkRelations

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`false`

Whether to display chunk parents, children and siblings.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunkssort)
stats.chunksSort

*   Type: `string`
*   Default:`"id"`

Sort the chunks by a given field. All of the [sorting fields](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#sorting-fields)
 are allowed to be used. Use `!` prefix in the value to reverse the sort order by a given field.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsids)
stats.ids

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`false`

Whether to display IDs of modules and chunks.

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#chunkgroup-options)
ChunkGroup options
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunkgroups)
stats.chunkGroups

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about the `namedChunkGroups`, see [chunk group object](https://rspack.rs/api/javascript-api/stats-json#entrychunkgroup-object)
 for more details.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunkgroupauxiliary)
stats.chunkGroupAuxiliary

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display auxiliary assets in chunk groups.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunkgroupchildren)
stats.chunkGroupChildren

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display children of the chunk groups (e.g. prefetched, preloaded chunks and assets).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschunkgroupmaxassets)
stats.chunkGroupMaxAssets

*   Type: `number`
*   Default:`5`

How many assets should be displayed in chunk groups.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsentrypoints)
stats.entrypoints

*   Type: `boolean | 'auto'`
*   Default:`false`

Whether to display the entry points with the corresponding bundles, , see [entrypoint object](https://rspack.rs/api/javascript-api/stats-json#entrychunkgroup-object)
 for more details.

When `stats.entrypoints` is set to `'auto'`, Rspack will decide automatically whether to display the entry points in the stats output.

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#module-options)
Module options
-----------------------------------------------------------------

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsmodules)
stats.modules

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about the built modules, see [module object](https://rspack.rs/api/javascript-api/stats-json#module-object)
 for more details.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsmoduletrace)
stats.moduleTrace

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display dependencies and the origin of warnings/errors.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsmoduleassets)
stats.moduleAssets

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to add information about assets inside modules.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsmodulesspace)
stats.modulesSpace

*   Type: `number`
*   Default:`15`

How many items of modules should be displayed (groups will be collapsed to fit this space).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsmodulessort)
stats.modulesSort

*   Type: `string`
*   Default:`"id"`

Sort the modules by a given field. All of the [sorting fields](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#sorting-fields)
 are allowed to be used. Use `!` prefix in the value to reverse the sort order by a given field.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsreasons)
stats.reasons

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about the reasons of why modules are included.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsreasonsspace)
stats.reasonsSpace

*   Type: `number`
*   Default:`1000`

How many characters should the reasons be displayed (groups will be collapsed to fit this space).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statssource)
stats.source

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`false`

Whether to display the source code of modules.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsdepth)
stats.depth

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`false`

Whether to display the distance from the entry point for each module.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsorphanmodules)
stats.orphanModules

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`false`

Whether to display the orphan modules.

> A module is an orphan if it is not included in any chunk.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsruntimemodules)
stats.runtimeModules

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about runtime modules.

> The runtime modules are built-in modules of Rspack, used to provide various runtime capabilities.

Tip

`stats.runtime` is a compatibility alias for `stats.runtimeModules`. It only takes effect when `stats.runtimeModules` is not specified; if both are set, `stats.runtimeModules` takes precedence.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statscachedmodules)
stats.cachedModules

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about cached (not built) modules.

Tip

`stats.cached` is a compatibility alias for `stats.cachedModules`. It only takes effect when `stats.cachedModules` is not specified; if both are set, `stats.cachedModules` takes precedence.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsexcludemodules)
stats.excludeModules

*   Type: `boolean | string | RegExp | ((name: string, module: any, type: any) => boolean) | Array<string | RegExp | ((name: string, module: any, type: any) => boolean)>`
*   Default:`false`

Exclude the matching modules information. This can be done with a string, a RegExp, or a function that receives the module name, module object, and module type and returns a boolean. `stats.excludeModules` can be an array of any of the above.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsnestedmodules)
stats.nestedModules

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about modules nested in other modules (like with module concatenation).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsnestedmodulesspace)
stats.nestedModulesSpace

*   Type: `number`
*   Default:`10`

How many items of nested modules should be displayed (groups will be collapsed to fit this space).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsnestedmodulessort)
stats.nestedModulesSort

*   Type: `string`

Sort the nested modules by a given field. All of the [sorting fields](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#sorting-fields)
 are allowed to be used. Use `!` prefix in the value to reverse the sort order by a given field.

Module grouping options

stats.groupModulesByAttributes

Whether to group modules by their attributes (errors, warnings, assets, optional, orphan, or dependent).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupmodulesbycachestatus)
stats.groupModulesByCacheStatus

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to group modules by their cache status (cached or built and cacheable).

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupmodulesbyextension)
stats.groupModulesByExtension

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to group modules by their extension.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupmodulesbypath)
stats.groupModulesByPath

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to group modules by their path.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupmodulesbytype)
stats.groupModulesByType

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to group modules by their type.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupmodulesbylayer)
stats.groupModulesByLayer

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to group modules by their layer.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsgroupreasonsbyorigin)
stats.groupReasonsByOrigin

Optimization options

stats.providedExports

Whether to display the exports of the modules.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsusedexports)
stats.usedExports

*   Type: `boolean`

stats.optimizationBailout

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#errorwarning-options)
Error/Warning options
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

stats.errors

Whether to display the errors.

stats.errorsCount

stats.errorDetails

stats.errorsSpace

stats.errorStack

stats.warnings

stats.warningsCount

Whether to display the warnings count.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statswarningsspace)
stats.warningsSpace

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#logging-options)
Logging options
-------------------------------------------------------------------

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statslogging)
stats.logging

*   Type: `'info' | 'none' | 'error' | 'warn' | 'log' | 'verbose' | boolean`

Whether to add logging output:

*   `'none'`, `false`: disable logging
*   `'error'`: errors only
*   `'warn'`: errors and warnings only
*   `'info'`: errors, warnings, and info messages
*   `'log'`, `true`: errors, warnings, info messages, log messages, groups, clears. Collapsed groups are displayed in a collapsed state.
*   `'verbose'`: log everything except debug and trace. Collapsed groups are displayed in expanded state.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsloggingdebug)
stats.loggingDebug

*   **Type:**

    type FilterItemTypes = RegExp | string | ((value: string) => boolean);
    type StatsLoggingDebug = boolean | FilterItemTypes | FilterItemTypes[];

Whether to display the debug information of the specified [loggers](https://rspack.rs/api/javascript-api/logger)
 such as Plugins or Loaders. When `stats.logging` is set to `false`, `stats.loggingDebug` option is ignored.

rspack.config.mjs

    export default {
      stats: {
        loggingDebug: [\
          'MyPlugin',\
          /rspack/, // To get core logging\
        ],
      },
    };

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsloggingtrace)
stats.loggingTrace

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display stack traces in the logging output for errors, warnings and traces.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statscolors)
stats.colors

*   **Type:**

    type StatsColorOptions = {
      bold?: string;
      cyan?: string;
      green?: string;
      magenta?: string;
      red?: string;
      yellow?: string;
    };
    
    type StatsColors = boolean | StatsColorOptions;

*   **Default:** environment-dependent

Whether to output in the different colors.

When an object is provided, it customizes the ANSI escape sequences used for each supported color. By default, Rspack enables colors when the current environment supports color output.

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#compilation-options)
Compilation options
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statshash)
stats.hash

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display information about the hash of the compilation.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsenv)
stats.env

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`false`

Whether to display the `--env` information.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsbuiltat)
stats.builtAt

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display the build date and the build time information.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsversion)
stats.version

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to add information about the Rspack version used.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statspublicpath)
stats.publicPath

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display the [`publicPath`](https://rspack.rs/config/output#outputpublicpath)
.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statsoutputpath)
stats.outputPath

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display the [`output.path`](https://rspack.rs/config/output#outputpath)
.

### [#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#statschildren)
stats.children

*   Type: `boolean`

Whether to display the [`output.path`](https://rspack.rs/config/output#outputpath)
.

stats.performance

.

stats.timings

*   Type: `boolean`
*   Default:`true`

Whether to display the timing information.

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#sorting-fields)
Sorting fields
-----------------------------------------------------------------

For `assetsSort`, `chunksSort` and `modulesSort` there are several possible fields that you can sort items by:

*   `'id'`: the item's id, an item is an asset, a module or a chunk.
*   `'name'`: the item's name that was assigned to it upon importing.
*   `'size'`: the size of item in bytes.
*   `'chunks'`: what chunks the item originates from (for example, if there are multiple subchunks for one chunk: the subchunks will be grouped according to their main chunk).
*   `'errors'`: number of errors in items.
*   `'warnings'`: number of warnings in items.
*   `'failed'`: whether the item has failed compilation.
*   `'cacheable'`: whether the item is cacheable.
*   `'built'`: whether the item has been built.
*   `'prefetched'`: whether the item will be prefetched.
*   `'optional'`: whether the item is optional.
*   `'identifier'`: identifier of the item.
*   `'index'`: item's processing index.
*   `'issuer'`: the identifier of the issuer.
*   `'issuerId'`: the id of the issuer.
*   `'issuerName'`: the name of the issuer.
*   `'issuerPath'`: the full issuer path.

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/stats#extending-stats-behaviours)
Extending stats behaviours
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you want to use the preset output behavior but want to output more or less of individual fields, you can customize the output behavior of the fields after specifying preset or all.

For example, only the error and the reason why the module was introduced are output.

rspack.config.mjs

    export default {
      stats: {
        preset: 'errors-only',
        reasons: true,
      },
    };

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/context#context)
Context
=====================================================

Copy Markdown

*   Type: `string`
*   Default:`process.cwd()`

The `context` configuration is used to set the base directory for Rspack builds.

`context` is an absolute path that is used as the base path for relative paths in Rspack configurations such as [entry](https://rspack.rs/config/entry)
 and [output](https://rspack.rs/config/output)
.

By default, Rspack uses the current working directory of the Node.js process as the base directory. In most cases, it is recommended to set a base directory manually, rather than relying on the current working directory of Node.js.

[#](https://rspack.rs/config/context#example)
Example
-----------------------------------------------------

For example, you can use [`__dirname`](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest/api/modules.html#__dirname)
 as the base directory:

ESM

CJS

rspack.config.mjs

    import { dirname } from 'node:path';
    import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
    
    const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
    
    export default {
      context: __dirname,
      entry: {
        main: './src/index.js',
      },
    };

rspack.config.cjs

    module.exports = {
      context: __dirname,
      entry: {
        main: './src/index.js',
      },
    };

In the above example, the `main` entry will be resolved based on the `path.join(__dirname, './src/index.js')` path.
